open_points.subject: Randomly minted record identities
open_points.text: `trial_execution_id` M07, `binding_id` M11, `run_id` M19, `approval_id` M24 and `grant_id` M25 are minted at random by the kernel; one that already exists is minted again.
open_points.question: Which module owns random identifier generation and collision retry, and what capability do `functions`, `bindings`, `runs` and `effects` use to obtain these identifiers?
options: `store` owns atomic minting and collision retry
Each record-writing module independently generates and retries identifiers
A separate lower-level randomness or identity module owns generation
open_points.default_guess: Make `store` mint each identifier and retry collisions atomically with the record write.

open_points.subject: Store failure during startup recovery
open_points.text: a store call that fails changes no record (A18 rules 3-4) and the request is answered as an internal error by `module:surface` (A16 rule 7)
open_points.question: What happens when a store call fails during `recover_in_flight_attempts` or `recover_running_runs`, when there is no request to answer and earlier per-record recovery calls may already have committed?
options: Stop startup, keep earlier committed recovery changes, and retry remaining recovery on the next start
Continue startup after skipping the failed recovery change
Roll back all recovery changes made during this startup
open_points.default_guess: Stop startup without opening the surface, preserve earlier committed recovery changes, and retry unresolved recovery work on the next start.
